title: Session::websocket_capability() clones raw JSON Value unnecessarily
description: websocket_capability() calls serde_json::from_value::<WebSocketCapability>(raw.clone()). The clone is forced by from_value taking ownership. Since the capability object is small (typically {url, supportsPush}), this is not a hot-path concern. Noted for completeness. Rewrite: deserialize via from_str on a serialized form, or accept the clone as the intended design given the small size.
